composite_prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: S01 exterior CLOSED-FOR-THE-NIGHT variant of the existing full composite C.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. Make only one scene-state change: all three visible windows have their interior lamps turned OFF. The glass should now be quiet dark dusty teal/grey with faint matte painted reflection rather than yellow illumination. Keep the sky, wall, roof, cloud, door, window frames, crescent hanging sign, tree canopy, vine, pots, paving, every position and shape, crop and native image dimensions unchanged. The existing wooden entrance door stays shut. Do not add shutters, padlocks, text signs, labels, people, moon, stars or any new object. Keep soft ambient night visibility so the wall and lane remain readable; do not crush the painting to black.
Preserve the existing gouache picture-book medium: visible brush strokes and dry-brush edges, slightly wobbly colored-pencil outlines, simplified shapes, slightly imperfect perspective, seven muted color families (cream, warm grey, walnut brown, sage green, dusty teal, faded plum, ochre), soft diffuse night light, cool-tinted shadows, sparse props, one focal point, matte paper. Full-bleed wide landscape.
NEGATIVE: glow, bloom, light rays, god rays, lens flare, bokeh, depth of field blur, gold filigree, ornate carvings, glossy/plastic surfaces, hyper-detailed clutter, photorealism, extra wisteria, text, letters, numbers, UI, blank labels or plaques, borders.
cleanplate_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: S01 CLOSED raw cleanplate B_all for actual same-position extraction of game layers.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. This is a local removal/edit, not a new scene. Remove ALL of these movable pieces from the existing painting and fill their previous locations with the plausible wall, roof, timber or sky behind them:
1. The leafy tree canopy at upper-left; retain the static main bare trunk and thick branches wherever visible, but remove the leaves.
2. The entire wisteria vine immediately above and down the left side of the entrance, including leaves, flowers and its winding vine stem. Restore the simple plaster and timber behind it.
3. The small crescent-shaped hanging wooden sign at upper-right of the door, including its little hanging chain and supporting metal bracket; restore plain cream wall.
4. The small white cloud in the sky.
Keep the entrance door and ring handle, all window panes and frames, stone wall, timber structure, roof, both herb pots, cobbled foreground, overall camera and crop EXACTLY as they are. Preserve all unedited pixels as closely as possible. Add no new objects, openings, labels or decoration. This remains the same closed-for-night ambient lighting, with all original windows still dark and all interior lamps OFF. Keep their painted dark glass and frame geometry unchanged. Do not alter lamp states or the colors of the remaining objects.
Maintain Image 1's matte gouache strokes, dry-brush marks, slightly wobbly colored-pencil edges and limited muted palette. Full-bleed landscape at the same native dimensions. No text, UI, plaques, frames, borders, people, glow, bloom or photorealism.
annotation_notes: Third actual processing round (initial real1 was only a visual annotation). Tree/vine ownership made disjoint; pale flower hues included through 255; crescent uses actual brown source contour instead of rectangular wall patch. Raster-run polygons encode actual native hard-mask rows; no art pixels generated.
